text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin suffers an injury during training, so I bring her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm fine, I'm fine. It's nothing serious, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: See, I'm all patched up now, so let's get right back to training!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Of course I'm sure! I can barely feel the pain anymore!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And I bet a bit of running will do wonders for my mood! I mean, I love running! ♪
choice_data_list: I'm still worried, so please rest up.
As long as you don't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Geez, you're being dramatic. I'm stronger than I look, you know.
choice_data_list: But what if your injury worsens?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ngh. Don't give me that look…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okay, fine. I'll rest up for today. I wouldn't want to worry you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A little disappointed, Ines Fujin returns to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Nice! I knew you'd say yes! Come on, let's hit the track!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the middle of her light jog, Ines Fujin's face crumples up in pain.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. And after I acted all cool back there. We might have to call it a day after all…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We cut our training session short, and Ines Fujin trudges back to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Phew. Looks like I should be okay if I keep the exercises light.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. I'm glad I powered through training, even with my injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While monitoring her injury, Ines Fujin completes a light training session.
